card.name: Product form words in dosing sections
card.fires_on: Words right after a drug or product name in dosage and administration text, such as 'available as', 'in', 'formulation' or 'combination'. Also fires on a slash or bracket in strengths and in the middle of brand names.

modes.label: Availability phrasing
modes.description: Small words after 'is available' or a drug name that lead into a form, container or diluent.
modes.example: ONSWIK is available<< as>> a single-patient-use prefilled pen

modes.label: Product-name follow-on words
modes.description: Words like 'combination' or 'formulation' after a drug name and strength.
modes.example: Midazolam 1 mg/mL<< formulation>> is recommended for sedation/anxiol

modes.label: Inside brand names and strengths
modes.description: Partway through a brand name, or at a slash or bracket in a strength or amount.
modes.example: Use aseptic technique to prepare<< Y>>ARTEMLEA. Parenteral drug

card.writes: It seems to push toward words naming a product, its type or its form.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to describe what form or product a drug comes in.
